name: website-review
title: Website performance brief
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM sites ORDER BY name

sections.title: Purpose and owner
sections.sql: SELECT name,owner,purpose,retention_days FROM sites WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Recorded imports
sections.sql: SELECT from_date,to_date,expected_count,added,source_ref FROM imports WHERE site_id=$1 ORDER BY from_date
sections.note: Date spans record declared scope, not proof that every day or visit is present.

sections.title: Acquisition
sections.sql: SELECT a.* FROM acquisition_review a JOIN sites s ON s.name=a.site WHERE s.id=$1 ORDER BY visits DESC

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due,state,closure_evidence FROM actions WHERE site_id=$1 ORDER BY due

name: privacy-review
title: Analytics record control review
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM sites ORDER BY name

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: SELECT rule,finding FROM compliance_findings WHERE site_id=$1
sections.note: Operational record checks, not legal certification.

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: SELECT actor,body,created_at FROM notes WHERE site_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
